QUESTION:
What was the default value of `snapshotter.batch_size` in PaderQueue 3.x?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0487] config | snapshotter.batch_size (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `snapshotter.batch_size` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of messages the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | messages |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `snapshotter.batch_size` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
batch_size = 100
```

---

# `snapshotter.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `64` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | messages |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `snapshotter.batch_size` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
batch_size = 64
```
